data.name: Prepare audited native resources and canonical icon
Set unique release build number and generate native project
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR/pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios"
# Codemagic's per-workflow CM_BUILD_NUMBER can collide with a build
# already present in App Store Connect after workflow history resets.
# Use the current UTC minute as a monotonically advancing numeric build
# identifier. App Store review submission remains disabled.
RELEASE_BUILD_NUMBER="$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M)"
export RELEASE_BUILD_NUMBER
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, re
p=Path('project.yml')
text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
updated,count=re.subn(r'(?m)^(\s*CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION:\s*)\d+\s*$', r'\g<1>'+os.environ['RELEASE_BUILD_NUMBER'], text, count=1)
if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit('CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION was not updated exactly once')
p.write_text(updated,encoding='utf-8')
print('PASS: Pharmacist release build number='+os.environ['RELEASE_BUILD_NUMBER'])
PY
xcodegen generate
python3 apply-xcode-capabilities.py PharmacistSprint.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleVersion' PharmacistSprint/Info.plist 2>/dev/null || true

data.name: Verify signed native release inputs
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios/Generated/questions.native.json"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon-1024.png"
grep -q 'com.apple.InAppPurchase' "$CM_BUILD_DIR/$XCODE_PROJECT/project.pbxproj"
! grep -q 'SystemCapabilities = "' "$CM_BUILD_DIR/$XCODE_PROJECT/project.pbxproj"
! grep -R -q 'WKWebView\|import WebKit' --include='*.swift' "$CM_BUILD_DIR/pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios"
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
p='pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon-1024.png'
assert hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()=='dfc7dfe4a1c13afbe98658cde591274e11665b016c39e2a4411de4dbe86127ec'
d=json.load(open('pharmacist-manabi-sprint/ios/Generated/questions.native.json',encoding='utf-8'))
q=d['questions']; active=[x for x in q if x['scoringStatus']!='excluded']
free=[x for x in active if x['exam']==111 and x['section']=='必須']
media=[x for x in q if x['displayMode']=='officialQuestionImage']
assert (len(q),len(active),len(free),len(media))==(1035,1031,90,154)
print('PASS: native pharmacist release inputs and canonical AppIcon')
PY
